description: This file defines a PHP class 'Weight' that manages the admin interface for shipping weight configuration in an OpenCart extension. It includes methods for rendering the configuration page ('index') and saving configuration settings ('save').

classes.name: Weight
classes.description: Controller class for managing shipping weight settings in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the shipping weight configuration page in the admin panel, setting up breadcrumbs, loading geo zones, tax classes, and other configuration data for display.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the shipping weight configuration settings submitted from the admin interface, with permission checking and JSON response.
